dtypes.requirement: All original input/output/compute dtype dispatches and implicit dtype parameters.

stages.explanation: Exact original kernel source; all 231 frontend-admitted fp16 configurations, the universal first-rejection partition and launch errors. The returned route executes all six statements through Host.run, discharges output injectivity, proves all payloads/frame and bounds integer/byte offsets. Frontend/native failures are propagated, never hidden as successful transpose.

Original randn/zeros shape, fp16 dtype, CUDA request, stride arguments, grid=(1,), original size parameters and exact Out return identity are bound to trusted primitive contracts. The unconditional public theorem covers all primitive outcomes; there is no successful-execution premise. Supported shape API is natural dimensions; unsupported Python caller conversion and negative dimensions belong to Torch primitive errors, with observed boundaries retained separately.

Non-JIT test_triton_vs_torch is not called by production kernel/wrapper. It calls wrapper for 16x16 and 32x64 and clones returned tensors. Import-time random test execution is a harness under the finite acceptance boundary; both production configurations are among the 231 proved cases.

dtypes.explanation: The original production wrapper hardcodes torch.float16 on both allocations; kernel pointers therefore load/store fp16 and transpose has no cast or arithmetic. arange and annotated stride products are int32; admitted element offsets are <2^20 and both fp16 bytes <2^21. All 65536 sampled words are covered without RNG/arithmetic assumptions.

initial_structural_gaps.finding: Actual wrapper fixes fp16 and grid=(1,); theorem covers arbitrary original strides/dimensions and six statements. Candidate closest to standard; need explicit wrapper parameter instantiation and final current binding check.

declarations.dtype_profile: Original wrapper hardcodes fp16 input/output. All BitVec16 sampled payloads; natural m,d, logical allocation into distinct regions and one original program. Native caller/error/shape admissibility and allocator/ABI are not established.

acceptance_boundary_review.domain: Original wrapper, canonical natural matrix dimensions, fixed fp16/CUDA allocations, one program; natural-shape rejection complement is preserved, arbitrary Python objects are not asserted supported.
acceptance_boundary_review.known_rejections: Nine complete natural-shape frontend partitions plus ordinary primitive error sites; negative/nonshape observed errors are preserved in wrapper-binding.json.
